video_title: Peyton Watson on His New Chapter in Cleveland & Playing With James Harden And Donovan Mitchell

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on bringing a fearless mentality to the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I'm fearless dog, I play the game with a lot of emotion.
quotes.quote: I think the right mentality and the right energy and the right personality to add to this team. I'm fearless dog, I play the game with a lot of emotion. I care about the game. It's not to me about what the game brings, it's about the game itself and preserving the quality of basketball and going out there and giving it my all. So I'm about all the right things. I'm going out there to play ethical basketball and help my guys reach something that's bigger than us.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he is bringing a fearless mentality to the Cavaliers and wants to play ethical basketball to help the team reach something bigger than themselves.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the importance of selflessness and team health
quotes.excerpt: If I'm not taking care of my body and I get hurt and I'm not able to play
quotes.quote: If I'm not taking care of my body and I get hurt and I'm not able to play, that affects the team. If I'm not getting my sleep, if I'm not getting my rest and I'm not ready to play, that affects the team. So a lot of times it's having that selflessness and stepping outside of yourself and doing what's best for the team.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson emphasizes the importance of selflessness and taking care of his body to ensure he is ready to help the team.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on studying film to integrate with teammates
quotes.excerpt: You got to know who you playing with, you got to know what their strengths are
quotes.quote: That matters. You got to know who you playing with, you got to know what their strengths are, things that they need help with. And I think that that's something that's going to be huge for our team as me help take pressure off those two star ball handlers and guys that we have holding the keys at the top. Making their drive easier in ways, and then they also make my job easier.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson on his role with the Cavaliers: He wants to study film and take pressure off the team star ball handlers to make their jobs easier.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on playing alongside star ball handlers
quotes.excerpt: They not as worried about being in help cause they like I'm guarding James Harden
quotes.quote: Playing with two guys on that level, when I get the ball and it's my time to rock, they not as worried about being in help cause they like I'm guarding James Harden, I'm guarding Donovan Mitchell. So that opens it up for me a little bit. So it's just having two guys on the team that are a threat constantly like them is huge.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says playing alongside James Harden and Donovan Mitchell makes his job easier because defenses are constantly worried about them.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on his physical development and shooting improvement
quotes.excerpt: I put on like 20 pounds this summer, and I really been at it.
quotes.quote: First and foremost thing that I worked on this summer is getting stronger, putting on weight. I put on like 20 pounds this summer, and I really been at it. I was 218, I was literally like 200 pounds soaking wet when I came into the summer. So I gained a little bit of weight and I feel better out there, my body feels stronger, I feel more on balance. And then something that I've been working on since I got in the league is just improving my three-point shooting and my shooting in general.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he put on 20 pounds of muscle this summer and has been focused on improving his three point shooting.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on embracing his G League experience
quotes.excerpt: A lot of guys shy away from it, but I embraced that because I knew I was
quotes.quote: I had to spend a little bit of time in the G League. And I remember I was one of those guys who embraced that. A lot of guys shy away from it, but I embraced that because I knew I was going to be able to go down there and play my game and figure some stuff out and figure out how it was going to go and what my game was really going to look like against pros.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson says he embraced his time in the G League when many other players shied away from it.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: Peyton Watson
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson on the preparation required for NBA success
quotes.excerpt: You got to show up every single day for four years in the NBA
quotes.quote: A lot of people don't understand that. They think that, oh, this dude got paid because of 15 games. This dude got paid because of two months of good basketball. And it's like, but y'all don't know what it took to put me in position to even get that opportunity for the 15. You got to show up every single day for four years in the NBA which are hard had on and not be late. And you got to be that guy who's next up. And a lot of people don't understand that that preparation is something that a lot of times you don't reap the fruits of your labor for a while.
quotes.social_post: Peyton Watson on the grind of the NBA: People do not see the years of preparation it takes to be ready when your opportunity finally arrives.
